reviews.x: The cream initially smells like 🍑 or spit. No, it ain't me honey... It's the cream for sure. The stick is awesome. Idk if it's just with the Vanilla scent or what. I'll try it again in another scent. Just wanted to let you know before you spend on the 2pc set.

Better than any other natural deodorant I have ever used.  Keeps the stinkfest away for a solid 72 hours, and is safe for the “netherlands”.  Summer crotch stink is a real problem for most ladies in AZ.  I recommend getting the 2 forms of Lume.  The lotion is just easier to place in the “netherlands”.  Skip the lime sent… sent is off.  Vanilla is nice though.  If you want a good giggle, watch a couple of ads for Lume on YouTube.

reviews.t: Even my grandson said I stunk!
reviews.x: Showered in the morning. Applied my Vanilla Lume. Loaded up the car heading home from Florida.  A few hours later, I raised my arm to adjust my seat belt and my 5-year old grandson asked, “Grandma , did you puke in your pants?” Which elicited laughter from all. Sadly though, he was correct  The smell emanating from my armpits was a combination of rotten onions and yeasty BO!  I still love my grandson BUT not Lume.

reviews.t: I hate the way I smell and this makes me feel so much better!
reviews.x: Ok so I feel like I never smell nice enough. The second I smell my own sweat I get so grumpy.. With Normal deodorant when you re apply it after you start sweating it just slightly scents your sweat.  This literally lasts 3 days and you have to only apply it once.  If you get stinky and put it on it candles out the smell instead of scenting it.  Literally will never stop buying this

reviews.t: It Smells Great, but Does't Work as It Claims
reviews.x: I actually bought Lume off of the website. The vanilla smells lovely, but it does not work for 72 hours or for 48 hours on me. It was very expensive and I was very disappointed when I bought it. I also got a pack with the deodorant lotion with sage and I do not like the smell at all (also, it did not last 24 hours on me). I am very disappointed I bought Lume and wish I could get my money back for it. I don't know how to returns work on Amazon, but the customer dissatisfaction policy isn't the be

reviews.t: The best anti-deodorant I have ever tried, will buy now for good.

I was hesitant about purchasing a couple of these. They are a bit pricey. But I am very glad I tried them. They actually work. I recommend you try it for yourself. It's a great product.
I thought the scent would wear off once dry but it tends to linger causing an odd scent.  However it does prevent other smells as advertised.

I really, really wanted to like this stuff. I have seen so many commercials for it and was hoping for success. I cannot get past the smell of the lotion. I’m a big fan of vanilla scented items but this stuff smells like vanilla scented poop. Wish I could return it but it’s already open.
It helps keep area dry for the most part. But I don’t care for the lotion one. It’s very expensive to use all the time as a deodorant. The lotion doesn’t work as well as the stick.
My grandson he’s play football, he’s smells after practice and games but not so much now it holds him really good the scent is vanilla

I was very excited to try this product after all the ads I’ve seen. But it was definitely a disappointment. It smelled (both the deodorant and the cream) very old and rotten. I’d like to think it was a delivery issue and the package was not delivered in a proper way and so it got to sit somewhere with a high temperature for a while before it was delivered to me (it’s just my thought and I could be wrong). So when I opened it, instead of smelling a nice warm vanilla scent, it was disgusting and s

My husband is scent sensitive and strong perfume scents make him ill. I like lume because it works and it doesn't have an over powering scent. The cream deodorant applies silky smooth and worms for an entire day.

reviews.t: OK if you want to replace one terrible stink for another terrible stink!!!
reviews.x: Using this product as advertised, I found it to be offensive rather than helpful!!!  In other words, it smells worse than my original B O!!!

reviews.t: Warm vanilla isn’t a fresh scent
reviews.x: If you’d like to smell like baked goods, this is for you. It doesn’t last 12 hours, let alone 72, in summer, but, in Fall and Winter, it may and might be nice. I will say that I tried to cancel this order within hours and got a response that ‘it was picked and packed’. Be sure that you want it!! And be aware that both the products I bought contain caffeine. I’m hypersensitive and wasn’t and was unpleasantly surprised.

Yeah this is weird but I got the vanilla and put some in armpits and under boob after a shower and the vanilla switched over to smell like a wet dog. Could be it does not mix with me but I had to reshower and it leaves a film that is hard to remove.

reviews.t: Buyer beware, it might be too good to be true
reviews.x: Fragrance is not clear, heavy scent of crème or lotion but nut the actual fragrance. Must reapply to be able to skip a shower. Too expensive for the actual product. I bought all components, soap, deodorant, wash, wipes. They are all disappointing.
It worked the first 2 weeks now the deodorant doesn’t work at all. I wish it kept working 😔. The vanilla scent smells like playdoh instead of vanilla.
Works great but the vanilla smells like bo …it’s horrible . Will not buy again.prefer native or Schmidt’s deodorants

reviews.t: Vanilla is not the one to get! If you get this!
reviews.x: Vanilla smell, I did not like at all! I had knots under my arms!

reviews.t: I love this product! Absolutely the real de!
reviews.x: This product dose exactly what it claims.

The solid stick doesn’t have a strong odor, but the lotion smells pretty awful. It reminds me of wearing a scented lotion and you smell the BO and the lotion. However, I am describing the scent before you even wear it. It seems to fade a bit once you wear it. It’s unbearable to me. I will keep using the stick and switch to non scented in the lotion.

The last batch I ordered was amazing. This one doesn’t work AT ALL! Within an hour I smell worse than if I had nothing on. It’s ruined a couple of shirts as I can’t get the odor out! This was previously the only deodorant that worked and didn’t make me bleed from irritation, but this batch is useless. Waste of money!

reviews.t: The delivery was fast thry arrived two days before the date supposed to arrive. Happy about that.
reviews.x: I chose vanilla scent, I do like the deodorant scent, but not the gel scent that came in the tube. For some reason they both vanilla scent, but I don't like how the gel smells. It's doesn't smells good like the deodorant stick. Maybe I'll get the unscented one next time.

reviews.t: Love the stick the tube smells like dirty feet!!
reviews.x: For the stick we absolutely love!! The smell is amazing and it's gentle enough for all over use an my little girl!! As for the tube it smells like dirty feet or butt!! Yuck!!! I was really looking forward to this product

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product effective at controlling odor, with several saying it lasts for days or works better than other natural deodorants.
A common complaint is that the vanilla scent smells unpleasant, off, or rotten rather than fresh.
Some reviewers say the product does not live up to its 72-hour or 48-hour claims, especially in warm weather.
Several reviewers mention the product is expensive or pricey.
Some reviewers prefer the stick form over the lotion/cream, saying the lotion doesn't work as well or they don't care for it.
